# American Fidelity Assurance Company — Employee Benefits Portal

> American Fidelity Assurance Company is a private supplemental insurance provider headquartered in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. This portal at secured-americanfidelity.com provides employees with access to their supplemental insurance benefits.

## Products
- [Disability Insurance (STD & LTD)](/disability-insurance): Income replacement when illness or injury prevents work
- [Cancer Insurance](/cancer-insurance): Cash benefits on diagnosis and during treatment
- [Accident Insurance](/accident-insurance): Cash benefits for accidental injuries
- [Critical Illness Insurance](/critical-illness-insurance): Lump-sum benefit on diagnosis of covered conditions
- [Hospital Indemnity Insurance](/hospital-indemnity-insurance): Daily cash benefit for hospital stays
- [Life Insurance & AD&D](/life-insurance): Death and dismemberment benefits

- [STD vs. LTD](/std-vs-ltd): Short-term vs. long-term disability differences
